purpose: Repair native stopped-turbine phantom thrust during zero-time initialization while preserving prior immutable packages.

source.scope: FGTurbine::Trim returns zero immediately when Running=false; stopped spool/fuel state retained, running idle and ordinary trim unchanged; native/WASM regressions and wrapper version metadata.

nativeStoppedThrust.scope: New method covers cold/hot-stopped RunIC for augmentation methods 0/1/2, repeated zero-time calls, retained spool/fuel, running idle and existing augmentation/nozzle contracts.

nativeRelatedTrim.note: Those two targets passed on final C++ source. The initial new stopped-thrust fixture in the same log needed an accepted step before cutoff; only its failed file was rerun and passes in native-stopped-thrust.log.

commands: node --test --test-concurrency=5 test/*.test.mjs (frozen SDK workspace and resolved native fixtures)
sdkBuildValidation.scope: One clean frozen-source build, locked toolchain, 5 compile jobs and 5 Node test workers.

installedRegressions.status: passed after a fixture correction and narrow failed-file rerun
installedRegressions.fixtureCorrection: Old Manual control-law test assumed Manual implicitly disabled automatic flaps. New separate default Auto-flaps control requires that pilot-flaps test to explicitly select Auto off.
installedRegressions.scope: 50 F35 allocation/control/conversion/reset/reload/augmentation cases, 17 yaw/mode cases, native audio/forces and identity/artifact tests.

negativeComparator.finding: After accepted main-only cutoff, RunIC returned 14999.211862 lb main dry thrust while Running=false. New installed fork11 case passes zero for all force carriers.

fullApplicationCi.note: Reused completed concurrent-session CI after source/artifact audit; final consumer build also includes shared force-direction correction.

browserLoadedAssets.scope: Installed fork.11 instantiated on hardware WebGL2 and WebGPU; not full-globe browser qualification.

limitations: Legacy trim-to-run startup initializes Cutoff=false as before; cutoff tests leave Trim through an accepted step before stopping. This release repairs already-stopped zero-time force rather than changing startup command semantics.
F35 lift allocation remains approximate geometry/capacity accounting, not shaft/clutch/bleed-flow calibration.
No upstream submission/push or package publication.
SDK full build tests establish software contracts, not aircraft performance, optics or acoustics.
